title: "Bond Example"
author: "gwf"
date: "9/23/2025"
output: pdf_document
---

First read in the data.

```{r}
bond <- read.table('bond.dat')
names(bond) <- c('ingot','metal','strength')
```

Load the mixed effects model library and run the model.

```{r}
library(lme4)
fit <- lmer(strength ~  as.factor(metal) + (1|ingot),data=bond)
summary(fit)
ranef(fit)
```

Load the nlme library and run the same model.

```{r}
library(nlme)
fit1 <- lme(strength ~ as.factor(metal), random=~1|ingot,data=bond)
summary(fit1)
logLik(fit1)
AIC(fit1)
fixef(fit1)
ranef(fit1)
```

Load lmerTest library and show anova

```{r}
library(lmerTest)
fit2 <- lmerTest::lmer(strength ~  as.factor(metal) + (1|ingot),data=bond)
anova(fit2)
anova(fit2,type=2)
```
